<section_guide number="3" title="Out of Scope" references="1,2">
<purpose>Optionally record explicit exclusions before the Demo Scenario is written.</purpose>

<inference_first>
Use the approved Overview and Solution and User Flow to identify possible boundary candidates, but
do not silently turn them into exclusions. If the user already made an exclusion explicit, draft
the list without asking again. Otherwise skip this optional Section unless a material boundary
remains genuinely ambiguous.
</inference_first>

<questions>
1. Has the user explicitly excluded any users, use cases, capabilities, screens, edge cases, or claims from this PoC?
</questions>

<workflow>
This entire Section is optional. Review Sections 1 and 2 only when the user has already stated an
exclusion or asks to clarify the boundary.

Record every confirmed exclusion in one concise Explicit Exclusions list. Do not split users,
features, edge cases, or unproven claims into separate required inputs. Do not invent non-goals, ask
the user to fill the Section, or treat an unresolved choice as excluded. If there is no explicit
exclusion, state that Section 3 will be skipped and do not call save_alps_section for it.
</workflow>

<completion required="false">Skip this Section when there are no explicit exclusions. Otherwise confirm and save 3.1 once.</completion>
</section_guide>
